summary: Fathom Holdings and Neighborhood Intelligence (NXH) jointly announced on September 24, 2026 an intent to explore a restructured transaction replacing their June 16, 2026 merger agreement; NXH would contribute its ~38.8% direct/indirect tZERO stake, Medici fund assets and GrainChain investment to Fathom, valued at no less than $130 million. The 8-K includes Rule 425/14a-12 communications, indicating a stock-based, merger-style structure still pending definitive terms. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or close date was disclosed; risk-arb focus is whether revised terms and proxy/solicitation timelines emerge or the deal collapses.
